char_4027_heyak.normal: Source .4 hit clock, maxAnimScale 1.2000000476837158, speed-12 projectile; live aerial ATK talent.
char_4027_heyak.S1: All ten ranks and stored charges; maximum two emitted speed-12 projectiles share one attack count. Exactly one receives Levitate before aerial damage. Invalid input at release is not counted; loss after emission cannot change the count.
char_4027_heyak.S2: All ten ranks; source .5 pre-delay and nine random releases, .05000000074505806 ASPD-scaled spacing. Every release samples current range; each emitted speed-11 projectile has its own fixed .05000000074505806 delay and Levitate dice. Emitted shots persist; unreleased repeats stop on control/expiry/retreat.
char_4027_heyak.S3: All ten ranks; source BAT +1.4 and range 3-10; target-free .5/maxAnimScale windup then three independent delayed births. Speed-1 nonhoming 1x1 collision squares select the nearest eligible enemy once, apply Levitate, then live ATK/air talent. Scale uses normalized lifetime curve plateau at .44280850887298584 of four seconds; collider lingers .12999999523162842 after hit.
char_4027_heyak.T1: Promotion/potential aerial ATK scaling, then damage-missable silence on successful HP receipts including shield absorption; immunity/Resist use the shared status engine.
char_4027_heyak.T2: Owned nonstacking Weightless inside current range, immediate entry and per-recipient .4000000059604645 HP checks; strict HP > .8. Removes its own source on departure/retreat.
char_4027_heyak.facing: Actual delivered Front/Back Attack and Skill_1 events at .4. S2 forces delivered Front Loop (no hit event); S3 has .867 presentation event but native attacks use .5 pre-delay. Activation/end clips and stale callbacks guarded by deployment/activation state.

verificationLimits: No frame-for-frame certification of compiled ability/FSM dispatch, damage-missability ordering, .4s aura entry/trigger clock, capped-animation/slow-ASPD interaction or random-selection sampling. The adapter runs at 30 Hz.

The compiled S3 ability-range mover, forceReachedWhenTimeup and end-position rule are unresolved. The local four-second expiry follows the literal native LIMITED lifetime; attachment notes describe disappearance at a five-tile centre. Exact final travel distance, collision boundary and native world-to-map transform are not certified.
Regular enemies currently use point hit bodies; huge-body intersections use the shared rectangle helper. Camouflage-specific native selection and tied-distance priority are not separately reproduced.
Original levitate/wind/bolt particles, audio and modules are not implemented. Tracked generic bolt/orb rendering is presentation scaffolding, not original effect parity.
The S2 fixed flight delay is retained, but its native random cosmetic emission offsets and interpolation are not implemented.

notes: S1 single-input condition counts emitted projectiles, unaffected by a victim dying during flight.
Skill Levitate resolves before the aerial talent.
T2 CN text specifies HP strictly above 80%.
S3 begins at the source centre and its two perpendicular one-tile offsets, with independent 0-.3s birth delays.
Moving 1x1 collision squares use live ATK and reach full scale after approximately 1.77 seconds.
Already emitted S3 winds persist after the owner leaves, without the off-field aerial talent.

The attachment describes disappearance at five tiles; the native prefab also carries LIMITED lifetime 4 and a compiled ability-range mover. The local adapter uses the literal four-second lifetime until that compiled end condition is recovered.
